annotations.title: Is our premium holding, or are buyers hunting for a cheaper way in?

description: Use when the user asks whether their price premium is holding, whether customers are trading down, or whether a price rise is hurting demand. Returns the share of the brand's US Google searches that look for a cheaper way in (price, cheap, discount, coupon, dupe, alternative, sale), against the year before, with a verdict (eroding, holding, strengthening) and each modifier's trend. Shares and bands only. Safe to cite: its controls are checked first, it states its limits, and every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. If a control fails it refuses and you are not charged. This tool charges nothing: it validates the request and returns a payment_url, the price and instructions. Pay by POSTing to payment_url over MPP (HTTP 402, a Stripe shared payment token from your wallet). Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. To have a sound result considered for publication on cultmath.com, add publish: true and question (what you were asked) to the POST body; CULT+MATH reviews every submission first. A real sample of this run, free: https://cultmath.com/agent/samples/premium-check.json
